regions.description: Disjoint regions partition the complete reference outline before editable opening voids are removed.

joint_owners.description: Column products owning common material at this full beam member joint. Source parts retain complete member geometry; physical beam parts exclude these owners.

thickness_direction.description: Authored slab thickness is a vertical offset; its direction is an inferred geometric convention, distinct from the sourced nominal slab dimension.

structural_parts.description: Owned native RC waist and riser-fill parts; disjoint from finish treads and landings.

path_offset.description: Signed metre distance from the authored reference path to wall centreline; positive to its left.

shared_voids.description: Existing geometric slab-void tags that explicitly share positive opening area; native opening pairs remain disjoint.

column_reserves.description: Explicit column products owning common structural and finish material. This is a material ownership reserve, not an architectural opening; full member geometry and analytical slab domains remain complete.
